pr_title: Add tests for multi_match phrase prefix query across multiple fields
pr_body:
This adds unit test coverage for a bug that was recently found in Lucene (see https://github.com/apache/lucene/pull/12260). We would have caught it earlier if we were testing the underlying lucene query being generated.

Closes #95738
pr_comments: The additional unit test will fail until we have upgraded to a Lucene version that fixes the bug upstream.

issue_context.title: multi_match lucene query broken since 8.7.0
comments: Thanks a lot for reporting this! It's a subtle bug caused by a change in Lucene 9.5.0 (https://github.com/apache/lucene/pull/11941). I will open a PR to fix this upstream.
I opened https://github.com/apache/lucene/pull/12260 to address this in Lucene.
